errors.title: Internal error
errors.default_next_steps: Report this bug with the support bundle.

errors.title: Configuration error
errors.default_next_steps: Check configuration file and CLI flags.

errors.title: Storage unavailable
errors.default_next_steps: Verify storage directory permissions and disk space.

errors.title: Cluster control plane unreachable
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the control service URL and ensure the control node is running and reachable.

errors.title: Destructive command confirmation required
errors.default_next_steps: Pass --yes for script execution or answer y at the prompt.

errors.title: Pipeline not found
errors.default_next_steps: Check pipeline name and ensure it has been created.

errors.title: Incompatible schema change
errors.default_next_steps: Review schema evolution rules; a new view may be required.

errors.title: Record decode error
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect the dead-letter queue for malformed records.

errors.title: Pipeline already exists
errors.default_next_steps: Use a different pipeline name or drop the existing one.

errors.title: Workload not found
errors.default_next_steps: Check the workload name; ensure it has been created with CREATE WORKLOAD.

errors.title: Workload already exists
errors.default_next_steps: Use a different workload name or drop the existing workload first.

errors.title: View is already paused
errors.default_next_steps: The view is already paused; use RESUME MATERIALIZED VIEW to restart it.

errors.title: View is not paused
errors.default_next_steps: The view is not paused; only paused views can be resumed.

errors.title: Non-monotone delta rejected in monotone recursion
errors.default_next_steps: Ensure the recursive query is monotone or restructure it; check EXPLAIN for recursion rules.

errors.title: Bootstrap interrupted; connector position lost
errors.default_next_steps: Verify connector positions, reset offsets, or perform a full bootstrap rebuild.

errors.title: View-on-view DAG contains a cycle
errors.default_next_steps: Resolve cycle in view dependencies; view-on-view relations must form a DAG.

errors.title: SQL statement could not be parsed
errors.default_next_steps: Check SQL syntax; see docs/language-features.md for the supported SQL subset.

errors.title: Query contains a feature not supported by the incremental planner
errors.default_next_steps: Simplify the query or check docs/language-features.md for the supported incremental SQL subset.

errors.title: Workload still has assigned views
errors.default_next_steps: Reassign or drop the workload's views before dropping the workload.

errors.title: Group-commit capacity exceeded; backpressure applied
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce epoch rate, increase GROUP_COMMIT_MAX_BATCHES, or add more shards.

errors.title: Aggregate running sum overflowed i64
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce value magnitudes or switch to a wider numeric type.

errors.title: MIN/MAX multiset retraction underflow: value has no positive weight
errors.default_next_steps: Ensure every retraction is matched by a prior insertion; check source event ordering and idempotency.

errors.title: TopK buffer overflow: too many unique rows in a single partition
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce partition cardinality, increase TOPK_BUFFER_LIMIT, or add more partition columns.

errors.title: View query could not be compiled into an executable operator pipeline
errors.default_next_steps: Simplify the query to a supported shape (see docs/language-features.md), or reference only base tables — views over other views are not yet compiled.

errors.title: Operator not found in pipeline
errors.default_next_steps: Run rockstream explain <view> --op-ids to inspect available operator IDs for this view.

errors.title: Arrangement key decoding failed or unsupported
errors.default_next_steps: Check arrangement key syntax or verify if the operator family key codec is supported.

errors.title: Migration state exceeded its configured timeout budget
errors.default_next_steps: Check donor/recipient shard health, then retry or abort the migration; increase the specific migration timeout only if the cluster is healthy but the workload is larger than expected.

errors.title: Inner-frontier stall in distributed recursion; per-shard recompute triggered
errors.default_next_steps: Check the step function for infinite cycles or skewed partitioning; review per-shard recompute logs.

errors.title: Distributed recursion max-iteration cap exceeded without convergence
errors.default_next_steps: Increase max_iterations or restructure the recursive query to converge faster.

errors.title: Lease acquisition rejected: shard already leased or fence token invalid
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect shard lease ownership and retry after lease re-acquisition.

errors.title: Recovery active for > 60s; pipeline freshness behind SLO
errors.default_next_steps: Monitor worker throughput and checkpoint progress; verify storage health.

errors.title: Shard is already leased by a different worker
errors.default_next_steps: Check worker assignments; another worker holds the lease. Use force-acquire if the holder is dead.

errors.title: Stale lease token; worker has been fenced out
errors.default_next_steps: Worker has been fenced out; acquire a new lease before retrying.

errors.title: Shard has no active lease
errors.default_next_steps: No lease exists for this shard; acquire a lease before operating on it.

errors.title: Write rejected: acting control node is not the current Raft leader
errors.default_next_steps: Retry the write against the current Raft leader (query cluster status for the elected leader's address); do not retry against this node until it wins a future election.

errors.title: Malformed table DDL statement
errors.default_next_steps: Check CREATE/DROP TABLE syntax against documentation.

errors.title: View not found
errors.default_next_steps: Check view name and ensure the pipeline is running.

errors.title: Query timeout
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce query scope or increase timeout.

errors.title: Unsupported isolation level
errors.default_next_steps: Use a supported isolation level (snapshot or eventual).

errors.title: Cannot drop inline view: dependent materialized views still exist
errors.default_next_steps: Drop all dependent materialized views first, or use CASCADE.

errors.title: Query rate limit exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce query rate, bundle queries, or increase tenant concurrency limits.

errors.title: Historical query beyond checkpoint retention window
errors.default_next_steps: Query a more recent epoch or timestamp, or increase the catalog's checkpoint_retention_duration.

errors.title: Idempotency key required for non-idempotent write
errors.default_next_steps: Provide a client-supplied idempotency key or an exactly-once source-epoch envelope.

errors.title: Optimistic transaction conflict: a concurrent write committed to the same key
errors.default_next_steps: Retry the transaction; if conflicts persist, reduce write concurrency or switch to a serializable protocol.

errors.title: Session wait-for deadline exceeded; query proceeded at current frontier
errors.default_next_steps: Increase session_wait_for_timeout or reduce write latency.

errors.title: Transaction RETURNING read-back could not find the row at the current frontier
errors.default_next_steps: Retry the write; if the row is consistently missing, check that the frontier used for the read-back has advanced past the commit epoch.

errors.title: Index is building
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for index backfill to complete.

errors.title: Index frontier lag exceeded limit
errors.default_next_steps: Index is too far behind view. Wait for synchronization or increase index_max_lag_ms.

errors.title: Index name conflict
errors.default_next_steps: An index with the same name already exists.

errors.title: Shard statistics are too stale for safe pruning; query fell back to a full scatter scan
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for the next checkpoint to publish fresh shard_stats, or increase shard_stats_max_age_checkpoints if this fallback is expected for the workload.

errors.title: Published frontier exceeded the session max_staleness bound; query proceeded
errors.default_next_steps: Increase rockstream.max_staleness, reduce publish lag, or switch to session_wait_for mode.

errors.title: Shard write buffer full; backpressure applied
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for downstream IVM processing to drain, then retry COMMIT.

errors.title: Subscribe consumer fell behind the change-log retention window
errors.default_next_steps: Reconnect with AS OF NOW WITH SNAPSHOT or increase CHANGE_LOG_MAX_ENTRIES.

errors.title: COPY FROM STDIN statement is malformed
errors.default_next_steps: Check COPY syntax; the statement must be COPY <table> [(<col>, ...)] FROM STDIN [WITH (...)].

errors.title: UPDATE/DELETE RETURNING clause is malformed
errors.default_next_steps: Check RETURNING syntax; it must be RETURNING * or RETURNING <col>[, <col>...] with no trailing content.

errors.title: Hop window state exceeded its configured overlap-aware bound
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce hop overlap, increase HOP_WINDOW_STATE_LIMIT, or shard the windowed stream more finely.

errors.title: Session window state exceeded its configured open-session bound
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce session cardinality, increase SESSION_WINDOW_STATE_LIMIT, or shard the windowed stream more finely.

errors.title: Query-time DataFusion source scan exceeded its configured bounded row/byte budget
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce source-table cardinality, add a LIMIT, or materialize the query into a view.

errors.title: Query-time DataFusion planning or execution failed for an ad hoc query
errors.default_next_steps: Simplify the query, validate referenced table/view schemas, or materialize the query into a view.

errors.title: CREATE INDEX automatic backfill scan exceeded its configured bounded row budget
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce table cardinality before indexing, or drop and recreate the index once the table is smaller.

errors.title: Late-data side-channel queue reached its configured bound / scatter topology unavailable
errors.default_next_steps: Drain the configured late-data sink, reduce late-event volume, or increase TUMBLE_WINDOW_LATE_ROUTE_LIMIT after verifying available capacity.

errors.title: Query-time scatter scan exceeded pathological row/byte budget
errors.default_next_steps: Narrow the predicate, add a LIMIT, or materialize the query into a view.

errors.title: Factorized payload exceeded its configured row or byte bound / scatter frontier mismatch
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce join fan-out, increase the factor payload bound after capacity review, or use the classic join path.

errors.title: Result set exceeded max_in_flight_rows bound
errors.default_next_steps: Add a LIMIT clause or paginate using cursors.

errors.title: Query was cancelled by a client CancelRequest
errors.default_next_steps: Retry the query or adjust client timeout settings.

errors.title: Cursor does not exist
errors.default_next_steps: Use DECLARE to open a cursor before FETCH/MOVE/CLOSE.

errors.title: Cursor already exists or cursor limit exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: CLOSE the existing cursor or use a different name.

errors.title: Per-connection memory limit exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: Close unused cursors, reduce result set sizes, or split the query.

errors.title: Query exceeded the configured statement timeout
errors.default_next_steps: Increase statement_timeout or optimize the query.

errors.title: Server-wide connection limit reached
errors.default_next_steps: Close idle connections or increase max_connections.

errors.title: Malformed INSERT VALUES list or schema mismatch
errors.default_next_steps: Ensure every VALUES row has matching parenthesis and correct column count.

errors.title: Commit epoch reached u64::MAX
errors.default_next_steps: Create a new shard before retrying.

errors.title: Unauthenticated: request missing or carrying invalid credentials
errors.default_next_steps: Provide valid credentials (Bearer token or mTLS certificate)

errors.title: Permission denied: authenticated principal lacks required RBAC role
errors.default_next_steps: Request elevated RBAC role from an admin or contact the namespace owner

errors.title: Namespace access denied: cross-namespace access attempt by non-admin principal
errors.default_next_steps: Switch to the correct namespace with SET search_path or request cross-namespace admin role

errors.title: --auth=mtls configured without tls_ca_cert_path; gateway refused to start
errors.default_next_steps: Set --tls-ca-cert-path (or gateway.tls_ca_cert_path in rockstream.toml) to the CA that signs client certificates.

errors.title: mTLS connection has no verified client certificate CN for its peer address
errors.default_next_steps: Connect with a client certificate signed by the configured CA over sslmode=verify-full; a bare TCP or TLS connection without a client cert cannot use --auth=mtls.

errors.title: Gateway TLS certificate/key/CA material failed to load or parse
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the configured paths point to valid PEM-encoded certificate/key files readable by the gateway process.

errors.title: mTLS handshake rejected: connection identity map is at capacity
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce concurrent connections or raise MAX_CONNECTIONS. The gateway rejected the handshake to avoid silently dropping the peer identity.

errors.title: Internal mTLS connection rejected: client certificate required
errors.default_next_steps: Configure internal TLS client certificates (--internal-tls-cert-path, --internal-tls-key-path, --internal-tls-ca-cert-path) so the node can authenticate with the cluster.

errors.title: Internal mTLS client certificate invalid, expired, or signed by an untrusted CA
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the internal TLS client certificate is valid, not expired, and signed by the trusted cluster CA root certificate.

errors.title: Presented client certificate node identity does not match registration payload
errors.default_next_steps: Ensure the node ID and role presented in the internal TLS certificate Common Name / SAN match the node registration parameters.

errors.title: Internal mTLS certificate rotation or reload failed
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the new certificate and private key files exist, have matching keys, and are signed by a trusted CA before triggering certificate rotation.

errors.title: Secret not found in secret catalog
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the secret name or run CREATE SECRET to define it.

errors.title: Secret already exists in catalog
errors.default_next_steps: Choose a distinct secret name or run ALTER SECRET to modify the existing secret.

errors.title: Secret encryption or envelope DEK wrap/unwrap failed
errors.default_next_steps: Check KEK provider configuration and key access permissions.

errors.title: Secret token is invalid, expired, or failed node-identity verification
errors.default_next_steps: Request a fresh secret token using valid mTLS node credentials.

errors.title: Secret DDL syntax or configuration is invalid
errors.default_next_steps: Check CREATE/ALTER SECRET syntax and required options (e.g. TYPE).

errors.title: Secret or KEK rotation failed
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the target KEK provider is reachable and active connectors are responsive.

errors.title: Secret drop rejected because it is in active use by a source or sink
errors.default_next_steps: Drop or alter referencing sources and sinks before dropping the secret.

errors.title: COPY target table does not exist in the catalog
errors.default_next_steps: Register the table with CREATE TABLE before using COPY FROM STDIN.

errors.title: COPY row field count does not match declared column count or invalid encoding
errors.default_next_steps: Check that the TSV row matches the column count declared in COPY or the catalog.

errors.title: Query cannot run inside a failed transaction block
errors.default_next_steps: Issue ROLLBACK to exit the failed block, then retry.

errors.title: Savepoint does not exist
errors.default_next_steps: Use SAVEPOINT <name> to create one before ROLLBACK TO.

errors.title: PREPARE TRANSACTION / XA two-phase commit is not supported
errors.default_next_steps: Use a single-phase COMMIT instead.

errors.title: Per-transaction savepoint limit exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: RELEASE earlier savepoints before creating new ones.

errors.title: Notify channel limit exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: UNLISTEN unused channels.

errors.title: Prepared statement limit exceeded for this connection
errors.default_next_steps: Deallocate unused prepared statements using DEALLOCATE.

errors.title: Portal limit exceeded for this connection
errors.default_next_steps: Close unused portals.

errors.title: Shard writer fenced out: lease lost
errors.default_next_steps: Acquire a new lease or refresh cluster leadership before retrying write.

errors.title: Pipeline blocked: object store brownout, local buffer exhausted
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce input rate or increase local_buffer_max_epochs; check object store availability.

errors.title: Self-fencing configuration invalid: self_fence_after constraint violated
errors.default_next_steps: Set self_fence_after so that: dead_after < self_fence_after < 2 × shard_recovery_budget.

errors.title: Merge operand malformed
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect the stored arrangement value; possible data corruption or law version mismatch.

errors.title: Legacy durable shuffle error (retired, use RS-3011..3016)
errors.default_next_steps: Upgrade to the granular durable shuffle error codes RS-3011 through RS-3016.

errors.title: Durable shuffle rate-limit retry budget exhausted
errors.default_next_steps: Object store is rate-limiting requests; reduce shuffle write concurrency or request a higher rate limit/quota from the object store provider.

errors.title: Durable shuffle generic object-store I/O failure
errors.default_next_steps: Verify object store connectivity, credentials, and bucket settings.

errors.title: Durable shuffle in-memory buffer capacity exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce per-epoch shuffle frame size or flush more frequently; increase MAX_DURABLE_BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES if the workload legitimately needs a larger buffer.

errors.title: Durable shuffle footer serialization failed
errors.default_next_steps: Report this bug with the support bundle; the index footer failed to serialize to JSON.

errors.title: Durable shuffle footer deserialization failed
errors.default_next_steps: The stored footer bytes are not valid JSON; the object may be corrupt or written by an incompatible version. Re-run the shuffle epoch.

errors.title: Durable shuffle footer is corrupt or undersized
errors.default_next_steps: The coalesced shuffle object is truncated or its footer-length header is inconsistent with the object size; re-run the shuffle epoch or restore from a prior checkpoint.

errors.title: Exchange IPC shuffle decode error
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect the Arrow IPC shuffle payload; possible truncation or a version mismatch between the writer and reader.

errors.title: Exchange loopback route target shard has no active ShardDb
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the target shard is registered and its ShardDb has been attached before routing; check shard assignment and worker startup order.

errors.title: Same-host shared-memory segment unavailable; exchange fell back to the direct path
errors.default_next_steps: Check same_host_shm_segment_bytes, same_host_shm_segments_per_peer, and host-level shared-memory permissions/capacity.

errors.title: Shuffle payload codec is unknown or decompression failed
errors.default_next_steps: Verify both peers advertise shuffle_codec_v1, inspect the payload bytes for corruption, and retry after rolling the cluster to a compatible build.

errors.title: Worker locality metadata is missing or stale; exchange fell back to the safe route
errors.default_next_steps: Check worker host_id/availability_zone registration, wait for topology refresh, or force the durable path during the rollout.

errors.title: Cluster checkpoint manifest codec decode error
errors.default_next_steps: Verify the control-plane capability floor, inspect the stored checkpoint manifest bytes for corruption, and finish the rolling upgrade before re-enabling manifest compression.

errors.title: Fast-path shuffle frontier read failed during replay dedup
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect target shard storage health and the committed frontier key; the frame was delivered conservatively, so verify downstream idempotency if the shard is unhealthy.

errors.title: Shuffle frame row budget exceeded worker.max_rows_per_quantum
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce exchange batch size/rechunking or raise worker.max_rows_per_quantum only if the worker can safely absorb a larger in-flight row budget.

errors.title: Unverified platform or compatible backend environment warning
errors.default_next_steps: Review the platform or backend compatibility matrix in docs/platforms.md; unverified environments are protocol-compatible but not qualified in release gates.

errors.title: Insecure container execution (root user or writable rootfs)
errors.default_next_steps: Run the container as unprivileged non-root user (UID 10001) with --read-only root filesystem and persistent /data volume mount.

errors.title: Platform port conflict on required listener port
errors.default_next_steps: Check for another process binding the requested port (5432, 9090, 9100, 9200) or specify an alternative address via CLI flags.

errors.title: Unsupported host platform, architecture, OS, or filesystem
errors.default_next_steps: Run RockStream on a supported 64-bit architecture (x86_64, aarch64) with modern Linux (glibc >= 2.31, kernel >= 5.4) or macOS, and ensure /data is on a local POSIX filesystem or supported S3 object store.

errors.title: Incompatible external database or broker version
errors.default_next_steps: Upgrade external PostgreSQL to version 12+ (14+ recommended) or Kafka broker to version 2.8+ (3.x recommended).

errors.title: Capacity sample batch flush failure
errors.default_next_steps: Check storage permissions and disk space for capacity measurement chunks, or reduce profiling sample rate.

errors.title: Invalid EXPLAIN INCREMENTAL ESTIMATE query or options
errors.default_next_steps: Check the SQL query syntax, target view name, and cardinality hints supplied to EXPLAIN INCREMENTAL ESTIMATE.

errors.title: Release candidate qualification gate rejected candidate evidence
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect qualification run failures, verify scaling floors, error ranges, and candidate identity invariants.

errors.title: Anti-cheat harness mutation or invalid execution detected
errors.default_next_steps: Verify multi-process worker isolation, distinct WorkerIds, active shard leases, and untampered timestamps.

errors.title: Merge-law accumulator wire bytes have the wrong size
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect the stored merge-law accumulator bytes; possible data corruption or an accumulator wire-format version mismatch.

errors.title: Checkpoint alignment buffer overflowed; bounded buffer capacity exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce input rate or increase checkpoint alignment buffer capacity; check for slow shards holding up barrier propagation.

errors.title: Cluster checkpoint recovery in progress
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for recovery to complete; monitor shard reassignment and frontier progress via SHOW VIEW STATUS.

errors.title: Pipeline freshness recovery SLO exceeded; RECOVERING_SLOW state
errors.default_next_steps: Recovery is exceeding SLO; check worker health, storage latency, and frontier progress. Escalate if recovery does not complete within expected bounds.

errors.title: Worker drain in progress; new shard assignments rejected
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for worker drain to complete, or target active workers for shard assignment.

errors.title: Shard load factor exceeds skew threshold; adaptive re-sharding scheduled
errors.default_next_steps: Allow adaptive re-sharding to complete or manually trigger partition splitting.

errors.title: Worker drain deadline exceeded; worker self-fenced
errors.default_next_steps: Investigate slow network/compaction preventing worker from draining; review worker logs.

errors.title: Schema change requires blue/green clone; in-place apply rejected
errors.default_next_steps: Perform a zero-downtime view replacement using a blue/green deployment strategy.

errors.title: A blue/green clone operation is already in progress for this view
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for the existing clone backfill to finish before starting a new one.

errors.title: Clone backfill lag exceeded the allowed threshold before flip
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce write load or check worker resource usage to allow backfill to catch up before flip.

errors.title: Worker drain target does not exist in the current topology
errors.default_next_steps: Verify target worker ID exists in active cluster topology before initiating drain.

errors.title: Worker drain cannot proceed because no active recipient worker is available
errors.default_next_steps: Ensure at least one active recipient worker is online before initiating drain.

errors.title: Worker drain queue reached its configured bound; backpressure applied
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for in-flight shard drain tasks to complete before enqueueing additional assignments.

errors.title: View is waiting on source/frontier progress
errors.default_next_steps: Check source/frontier health and producer lag; verify watermark advancement for the upstream source.

errors.title: View admission rejected by quota controls
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce state pressure, free quota in competing workloads, or adjust admission and memory budgets before retrying.

errors.title: View lag is dominated by spill delay
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce spill pressure by lowering hot-key skew, increasing memory budget, or reducing ingest burst size.

errors.title: View is in over-budget relaxed mode
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce view memory usage or increase workload memory limit so the view can exit relaxed mode.

errors.title: View checkpoint alignment is stalled
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect checkpoint barrier holders and slow shards; resolve stalled operators before retrying.

errors.title: View sink commit path is blocked
errors.default_next_steps: Check sink connectivity/commit latency and transactional backpressure; recover sink health before retrying.

errors.title: View topology transition is in progress
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for migration/drain to complete, or inspect topology transition progress and blocked shard ownership.

errors.title: View is recovering from checkpoint/reassignment work
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for recovery to complete; monitor checkpoint and shard reassignment progress via SHOW VIEW STATUS.

errors.title: Source connection failed or table already exists
errors.default_next_steps: Verify source connection settings and network connectivity.

errors.title: Sink write failed
errors.default_next_steps: Check sink availability and credentials.

errors.title: Sink 2PC pre-commit failed; epoch not staged
errors.default_next_steps: Retry the epoch; check sink connector health and connectivity.

errors.title: Sink 2PC commit failed after pre-commit; recovery required
errors.default_next_steps: Trigger manual recovery or restart the connector; check sink idempotency profile.

errors.title: Sink 2PC duplicate delivery detected and suppressed
errors.default_next_steps: This is informational; the duplicate was suppressed. Check the source for duplicate delivery.

errors.title: Source-epoch registry full; too many uncommitted epochs in flight
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce source epoch rate or increase max_in_flight_source_epochs.

errors.title: CREATE SINK DDL parse or validation failed
errors.default_next_steps: Check CREATE SINK syntax, referenced view name, and WITH option types; use catalog=filesystem|glue|rest|hive|ducklake.

errors.title: CREATE SOURCE DDL parse or validation failed
errors.default_next_steps: Check CREATE SOURCE syntax, connector options, and source credentials.

errors.title: Source not found
errors.default_next_steps: Check the source name and ensure it has been created.

errors.title: Source already exists
errors.default_next_steps: Use a different source name or drop the existing source first.

errors.title: PostgreSQL CDC replication cannot proceed without recovery
errors.default_next_steps: Repair the PostgreSQL slot or publication, then run the bounded resnapshot workflow.

errors.title: Source owner registration requires checkpoint recovery
errors.default_next_steps: Run checkpoint recovery before registering the source owner, then retry owner registration.

errors.title: PostgreSQL CDC protocol or ownership validation failed
errors.default_next_steps: Validate pgoutput protocol, source identity, slot ownership, and durable routing before retrying.

errors.title: Source bounded in-flight capacity was exceeded
errors.default_next_steps: Drain the source or reduce transaction and epoch size before increasing the configured bound.

errors.title: Source checkpoint fence did not advance monotonically
errors.default_next_steps: Recover the highest committed source checkpoint and retry with the next fenced epoch.

errors.title: Source checkpoint acknowledgement failed
errors.default_next_steps: Retain source ownership, recover the committed checkpoint, and retry upstream acknowledgement.

errors.title: Connector has been removed
errors.default_next_steps: Use an external loader through pgwire or Kafka for S3 input, an external HTTP-to-Kafka (or HTTP-to-PostgreSQL) adapter for webhooks, or RockStream to Kafka to a downstream writer for sink output.

errors.title: Source epoch exhausted
errors.default_next_steps: Create a new connector before retrying.

errors.title: Source backfill cursor or lifecycle is invalid
errors.default_next_steps: Recover or recreate the committed backfill cursor or lifecycle, then retry.

errors.title: Backfill live-delta buffer is full
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for snapshot catch-up or reduce live-delta volume before retrying.

errors.title: Backfill admission reservation rejected
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for a backfill to finish or reduce BACKFILL_LIVE_DELTA_MAX_BYTES before retrying.

errors.title: Materialized view backfill is not published
errors.default_next_steps: Run SHOW BACKFILL STATUS and retry after the materialized view reaches RUNNING, or create it first.

errors.title: Quota or backpressure refusal during ingestion burst
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce ingestion rate or increase quota allocation.

errors.title: Incompatible storage format
errors.default_next_steps: Run rockstream migrate --from=N --to=M --storage=<url> before upgrading the binary.

errors.title: Unknown merge law in arrangement header
errors.default_next_steps: Register the merge law or migrate the arrangement before attaching the shard.

errors.title: Legacy validation failure
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect the failing component and its version-specific validation guidance.

errors.title: Quota counter overflow detected
errors.default_next_steps: Release quota or create a new workload before requesting additional capacity.

errors.title: Resource usage budget warning (80% threshold reached)
errors.default_next_steps: Examine view resource usage and plan to scale out cluster capacity or adjust memory limits.

errors.title: Resource usage budget critical (95% threshold reached)
errors.default_next_steps: Immediately free unused view resources or scale cluster capacity to prevent pipeline stalls.

errors.title: Wire protocol version not supported; rolling upgrade version skew
errors.default_next_steps: Use a peer with an overlapping protocol range, or finish the rolling upgrade before retrying.

errors.title: Object store latency or amplification budget breach
errors.default_next_steps: Check object store performance, batch sizes, and write amplification.

errors.title: Window partition size exceeded skew warning threshold
errors.default_next_steps: Add partition keys to distribute window load across shards.

errors.title: Illegal shard-migration state transition rejected
errors.default_next_steps: Drive the migration through the documented next state only, or resume from the persisted record instead of forcing a skipped state.

errors.title: Shard-migration verify scan window exceeded its configured bound
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce verify_sample_rate, split the migration into fewer buckets, or increase the configured verify scan bound if memory headroom allows.

errors.title: Shard-migration bucket-map version or watcher acknowledgement mismatch
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for every reader, exchange receiver, and gateway to observe the new bucket_map_version, then retry the migration step under the current version.

errors.title: Donor reclamation is not frontier-safe in current state
errors.default_next_steps: Wait for migration state machine to advance to a safe reclamation state.

errors.title: Migration verification divergence detected for key
errors.default_next_steps: Inspect donor and recipient shard state; reconcile divergent keys.

errors.title: Skew-bound SLO cannot be met without composable partial-state splitting
errors.default_next_steps: Add composable partial-state semantics for this operator, reduce the hot key's skew at the source, or route the workload to a spill-shard plan that can tolerate the SLO miss.

errors.title: Non-composable hot key routed to a single spill shard
errors.default_next_steps: Keep the hot key on a single spill shard, watch that shard's pressure, and switch to a composable law before enabling virtual-bucket splitting for this workload.

errors.title: Incompatible upstream schema evolution detected
errors.default_next_steps: Apply view replacement or run manual migration to match the new upstream schema.

errors.title: Frontier aggregator shard registry is full; new shard reports rejected
errors.default_next_steps: Scale out frontier aggregators (add more nodes with --role=frontier) or reduce shard count below the configured limit.

errors.title: Stale fencing token on frontier-aggregator publisher-lease CAS or publish
errors.default_next_steps: Re-acquire the publisher lease under the current fence token before retrying; this aggregator has been fenced out by a newer publisher.

errors.title: Sync-flush-before-lease-handoff-read violation on frontier publication
errors.default_next_steps: Verify every publish_frontier write path uses WriteOptions { await_durable: true }; this indicates a durability regression in FrontierLeaseStore.

errors.title: Admission control rejected the capacity request
errors.default_next_steps: Reduce the requesting workload's demand, raise the cluster state budget, or lower the priority of contending workloads so admission control can pause them.
